extracted.intended_audience: researchers applying for NIH PHS 398 / K08 career development awards; grants administrators preparing Research & Related budgets and supplemental forms
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation of a PHS 398 / Research & Related budget, budget justification, biosketch contributions, and Career Development (K08) supplemental form content for an NIH career development award application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe key scientific contributions, contextualize their novelty/impact, and cite representative publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide narrative statements explaining the significance of the work, how it advanced the field, subsequent influence (e.g., follow-up studies), and list supporting publications (with full citation details or PMID/PMCID).

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: List relevant positions (with dates) and honors/awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include academic and clinical positions, residencies/fellowships, board certifications, clinical licensures, and notable awards or scholarships with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete Bibliography Link (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a link to the complete list of published work in My Bibliography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the persistent NCBI/MyBibliography URL for the applicant's full publication list; indicate sort/order if relevant (e.g., sort=date ascending).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ongoing Research Support (Research Support section)
rubrics_metrics.description: List ongoing grants/support (grant number, PI name, dates, role, and a brief description of how the support relates to the proposed work).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include grant number (e.g., 5T32AI007291-27), PI name, project dates, award title (e.g., Institutional Training Grant), and the applicant's role (e.g., Fellow); describe what the support covers (salary, training) and relevance to the proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section A: Senior/Key Person
rubrics_metrics.description: For each senior/key person include prefix, name, project role, base salary, calendar/academic/summer months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the person’s name and role (e.g., PD/PI), percent effort in months (e.g., 9.6 calendar months), requested salary and benefits, and attach files if additional senior/key persons are listed. Ensure totals are reported for all Senior/Key Persons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section B: Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Report number and types of other personnel, their project roles, calendar/academic/summer months, requested salaries, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include counts and dollar amounts for categories such as Postdoctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical; compute totals for other personnel and for salary/wages + fringe benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section C: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide detailed descriptions and amounts for each equipment item > $5,000; attach an Additional Equipment file if needed; report total equipment funds requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section D: Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide budgeted funds for domestic and foreign travel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate domestic travel (includes Canada, Mexico, U.S. possessions) and foreign travel costs; include purpose (e.g., conference presentations) in the budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section E: Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and Number of Participants/Trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide per-year and total amounts, number of trainees, and itemize participant support costs separately from other direct costs; totals should be reported for Section E.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section F: Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize other direct cost categories: Materials and Supplies; Publication Costs; Consultant Services; ADP/Computer Services; Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; Alterations and Renovations; and other specified 'Other' categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each category with dollar amounts and attach supporting files if necessary; include any additional 'Other' line items with explanation in the budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section G: Direct Costs total
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize total direct costs (Sections A through F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a consolidated total of all direct cost sections (A–F) for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section H: Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report indirect cost type, MTDC (Modified Total Direct Costs), cognizant federal agency information, indirect cost rate (%), indirect cost base ($), and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the indirect cost rate and base, list the cognizant federal agency (name and contact), and compute total indirect costs to include in the budget totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section I: Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide funds requested as the sum of direct and indirect costs (G + H).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure arithmetic consistency and report totals clearly; include this combined total in the cumulative budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section J: Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, include requested fee amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report any fee requested and include it in the grand total (K).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section K: Total Costs and Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Report total costs and fee (I + J).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the final total for the budget period including direct, indirect, and any fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain personnel effort, responsibilities, salary/benefits, and why salary support is requested or not for key personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify PI percent effort (e.g., 9.6 calendar months / 80% effort), primary responsibilities (study design, data collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation), fringe benefit rate (e.g., 34%) and what it comprises; state whether salary support is requested for other key personnel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Laboratory Supplies and Computing
rubrics_metrics.description: Justify requested funds for laboratory supplies, reagents, sample identification and shipping, IT management, software, and computing hardware/upgrades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State per-year requested amounts, list off-site sample sources and shipping needs, justify IT management costs, software purchases, and planned laptop/computer upgrades (including timing, e.g., Year 4).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Education, Travel, and Publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Request and justify tuition, travel to scientific meetings, and publication/printing costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide per-year tuition amounts (identify schools/programs and coursework), travel cost estimates (registration, airfare, lodging, per diem) for presentation of results, and per-year publication costs for first-author manuscripts and poster printing; indicate totals over the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement: List items > $5,000 (Equipment policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: List items and dollar amount for each equipment item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit form instruction; ensure each equipment line item above the threshold is individually listed and justified.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Vertebrate Animals Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer whether vertebrate animals are euthanized and, if yes, whether the method is consistent with AVMA guidelines; if 'No' to AVMA, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checkbox response required; if euthanasia occurs, explicitly state consistency with AVMA guidelines or provide justification for deviations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Program Income Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether program income is anticipated and, if yes, report anticipated amount(s) and source(s) by budget period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', use the specified format to list budget period, anticipated amount ($), and sources; if 'No', leave blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the project involves human embryonic stem cells (hESC); if yes, list registry number(s) or check the box that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific registration numbers from the NIH registry or check the provided option if a specific line cannot be referenced at submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Inventions and Patents (Renewals)
rubrics_metrics.description: For renewal applications, indicate whether inventions/patents exist and whether they were previously reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer Yes/No and if Yes, indicate Previously Reported: Yes/No as requested by the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Change of Investigator/Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, indicate change of PD/PI or grantee institution and provide former PD/PI name or former institution information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the appropriate boxes and supply the requested identifying details for any changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form — Required Sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the listed application parts: Introduction (for Resubmission/Revision), Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List (for Renewal), Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research, Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring, Plans and Statements of Mentor/Co-Mentor(s), Letters of Support from Collaborators/Contributors/Consultants, Description of Institutional Environment, and Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each named section must be completed and appropriate supporting documents attached (e.g., Candidate_Section_Antar-K08.pdf, Specific_Aims_K08.pdf, Research_Strategy_Antar-K08.pdf, Statement_of_Mentor_CoMentor.pdf, FINAL_LOSs_Collaborators_Contributors_Consultants.pdf, Description_of_the_Institutional_Environment_Antar-K08.pdf). Follow page/formatting rules in the application guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Attachment and File Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach required files (Budget_Justification.pdf, Additional Equipment file, other single-file restrictions) and indicate mime types where requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form allows only one attachment for some sections (e.g., 'Only attach one file.'); provide file names and correct mime types; ensure attachments contain the detailed justifications and itemizations referenced in the form fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative Budget Table Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a cumulative budget table summarizing Sections A–K across budget periods including totals for Salary, Equipment, Travel, Participant Costs, Other Direct Costs, Direct Costs, Indirect Costs, Total Direct+Indirect, Fee, and Total Costs and Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report numeric totals clearly; ensure consistency between per-period budgets and the cumulative summary; include number of participants/trainees and any Other line items with amounts.
